# Public Codex app-server request schema fixture

Generated by the official Codex CLI `0.165.0-alpha.1.2` (app `26.1023.50603`) and explicitly supplied by the user for Sticker installation validation. These four public protocol-definition files contain no runtime configuration, identities, credentials or environment values.

Original UTF-8 bytes are preserved, including numeric `0.0`; the regression checks each size and SHA-256. The source subset was 10,385 bytes with SHA-256 `3aef7e9f077de4f3573620b4149b8dbec62aba6ba6b293d82062a0f2ab0f9837`. Do not format or normalize these JSON fixtures.

The actual status request name is `ListMcpServerStatusParams`. Its nullable integer limit has `format: uint32` and `minimum: 0.0`, without an explicit maximum. Sticker enforces the unsigned 32-bit range itself. Passing this schema regression is not proof of the original Mac GUI/pipe/installation lifecycle.
